articles.summary: Property claims do not have to be complicated. From eFNOL to claim settlement, there are tried-and-true digital tools that simplify the customer experience, reduce costs, speed up cycle time, and, most importantly, improve customer satisfaction. In other words, these solutions help make insurance convenient.
articles.title: Making Property Claims as Simple as One, Two… Three!

articles.summary: What do skiing and insurance have in common? Well, beyond the obvious need to properly assess the risk or chance of failing miserably, ski resorts have become the theme for Guidewire cloud releases — starting with the Aspen and Banff releases in 2020 and continuing with the latest Cortina release.
articles.title: InsuranceNow Embeds More Intelligence and Enhances Cloud Performance with Cortina Release
